subject: Mica
text: Mica randomly telepaths with you and gives you clues throughout the journey.

evidence.quote: Mica randomly telepaths with you and gives you clues throughout the journey.

subject: Cleopatra
text: Cleopatra will give you a hint for the tetrad in exchange for bringing her a pizza.

evidence.quote:
Cleopatra 
-----------------------------
The first historical person you meet, she will give you a hint for the tetrad 
in exchange for bringing her a pizza.

subject: Sherlock Holmes
text: Sherlock Holmes lets you know about Zoda Y trying to steal a tetrad from the local museum, and will try his best to help capture Zoda Y.

evidence.quote:
Sherlock Holmes 
-----------------------------
I never expected to find this guy in this game. He will let you know about 
Zoda Y trying to steal a tetrad from the local museum, and will try his best 
to help you capture Zoda Y.

subject: Leonardo Da Vinci
text: Leonardo Da Vinci will lend you his flying machine.

evidence.quote:
Leonardo Da Vinci 
-----------------------------
He will lend you his flying machine, and this leads to a hilarious moment with 
him where Mike offers a solution for the Mona Lisa.

subject: King Arthur
text: King Arthur needs your help in slaying a dragon that has been terrorizing his castle, and will give you a reward in return.

evidence.quote:
King Arthur 
-----------------------------
Needs your help in slaying a dragon that has been terrorizing his castle, and 
will give you an awesome reward in return.

subject: Merlin the Magician
text: Merlin the Magician gives you magical weapons throughout the game, as well as helps you when you get a game over.

evidence.quote:
Merlin the Magician 
-----------------------------
He will give you magical weapons throughout the game, as well as help you when 
you get a game over.

subject: The Chief
text: The Chief helps you put the Tetrads together.

evidence.quote:
The Chief 
-----------------------------
The big fat chubby guy from the 1st game makes his return as well, helping you 
put the Tetrads together.

subject: Zoda
text: Zoda is the main villain of the game and must be fought several times.

evidence.quote:
Zoda
-----------------------------
The main baddy of this game. Expect to fight him several times!

subject: Mike
text: It takes Mike about half a second to turn when you push the button.

evidence.quote: It takes Mike about half a second to turn when you push the button.

subject: Mike
text: Mike can only jump one space at a time, unless you have the special item that allows you to make two tile jumps.

evidence.quote:
Remember that Mike can only jump one space at a time, so don't make those 
two tile jumps, unless you have the special item that allows you to.

subject: Special items
text: Save weapons and special items for when you need them because you do not get an unlimited amount of them.

evidence.quote:
Save the weapons and special items for when you need them. You don't get an 
unlimited amount of them, so don't waste them on easy enemies or bosses.

subject: BIG HEART
text: The BIG HEART is an automatic item that increases your max life level by 1.
